{{Quote|The Lady of Pain runs a compound not far from here. Bad part of the desert. You can't miss it.|[[Ann'ya]]|<ref name="TOR:CV">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Confronting Veeboo|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
The '''Lady of Pain's compound''' was a gladiatorial arena and compound owned by the [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] known as the [[Lady of Pain]]. The compound was located off of the southern end of the [[Jundland Chasm/Legends|Jundland Chasm]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and featured an open-air arena for [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] combat.<ref name="TOR:ABwtLoP" />
